dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish knows that Nara is good at finding things, and very soon, Nara would find the one Aradanish wants.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: This time, what Aradanish wants... Hay. <color=#00E1FFFF>A lot of hay, bundled together</color>. "Time is ticking," and Nara needs to be fast, very fast.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have the time right now.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish will wait until Nara is free.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Golden Nara is as fast as they said!

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Only good Nara plays games with Aradanish. This is for friend Nara!

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: No, no, Aradanish doesn't want that. Nara needs to think again.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish will always be here. Come back anytime Nara wants to play a game.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Nara, it's Nara. Come to play games with Aradanish?
